projectName: BINZO — Smart Autonomous Mecanum Dustbin Robot
projectDescription: Autonomous holonomic service robot platform powered by an M5Stack Core2 (ESP32) controller with a 320x240 capacitive touch dashboard. ojasSinghContribution: Full robot systems architecture: M5Core2 firmware, 4WD Mecanum holonomic inverse kinematics solver, M5Module4EncoderMotor I2C driver integration, Port B/C hardware pinout allocation, K210 YOLOv2 visual servoing UART pipeline, 320x240 touchscreen UI diagnostics, non-blocking FSM mission state machine, and UDP telemetry bridge.
engineeringScope: 4WD Mecanum wheel holonomic vector kinematics (forward, strafe, axial yaw)
I2C 4-channel motor encoder driver (M5Module4EncoderMotor at addr 0x24)
Port B dual TCRT5000 IR line patrol sensor integration (L26 / R36)
Port C UART2 high-speed communication with Kendryte K210 edge AI coprocessor
Closed-loop optical visual servoing for human approach and tracking
MG90S 50 Hz PWM servo lid mouth articulation with acoustic audio tones

projectDescription: Offline-first, dual-factor physical access controller merging a self-hosted Wi-Fi SoftAP authentication portal with an 8-pin 4x4 matrix keypad, 16x2 I2C character display, and 50 Hz hardware PWM servo door latch. Operates with zero router or internet connectivity by generating cryptographically fresh single-use One-Time Passcodes (OTPs) displayed on a responsive local dark-theme web portal and validated on a debounced physical keypad via a deterministic non-blocking finite state machine.
contributors: Ojas Singh (Lead Embedded & Hardware Systems Architect)
ojasSinghContribution: Complete hardware architecture, Infrastructure-as-Circuit (IAC) pinout allocation, non-blocking millis() FSM design, debounced 4x4 matrix keypad scanning, I2C 16x2 LCD driver integration, 50 Hz hardware LEDC PWM servo latch control, self-hosted SoftAP HTTP server implementation, dynamic OTP generation logic, and isolated power decoupling design.
engineeringScope: Self-contained Wi-Fi SoftAP portal ('ESP32-SmartLock', 192.168.4.1) serving responsive dark-theme UI directly from MCU flash
Dynamic single-use 4-digit OTP generation (1000-9999) with automatic expiration and regeneration
8-pin 4x4 matrix keypad debounced scanner across 8 GPIOs (R1:13, R2:32, R3:33, R4:25, C1:26, C2:27, C3:14, C4:12)
I2C 16x2 character LCD driver at address 0x27 on GPIO 21 (SDA) / GPIO 22 (SCL)
50 Hz hardware LEDC PWM servo door latch controller on GPIO 18 (0 deg Locked <-> 90 deg Unlocked)
Pure non-blocking millis() finite state machine (zero delay() calls in loop())
Isolated 5V 2A power rail with bulk electrolytic (100uF) and ceramic (0.1uF) decoupling capacitors to prevent brownouts
